name: Stride
author: Sellchaze
description: A high-energy theme for sneaker, sportswear and fitness stores: night or court grounds with a volt or race-red accent, oversized slanted display type, drop countdowns, a size-chart finder, shop-by-sport tiles, a snap-scrolling new-drops rail and a kit builder — on a dense, grid-first product layout with colour dots and new / low-stock badges.
changelog: 1.0.0 (2026-10-24): Initial release — sports & sneakers theme on the shared section library.
